items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1966-03-09
items.q: this same man that learned me I used to be around his band most of the time. Billy Moran. Billy Moran, he had the Olympia band... he'd let me sit on in... because he'd be learning me.

ctx.x: Well I just don't know whose band they were and what the music was like.

Yeah well this same man that learned me I used to be around his band most of the time. Billy Moran. Billy Moran, he had the Olympia band. And this boy I know who used to play, I know Matoya, he was playing with them. And Big Sidney, Sidney Dave was playing Crannert, you know him. Well that's another tough man. And John Moran was playing guitar. He was playing guitar. But he was a tough man. And after, well I'd go around by him all the time, he'd let me sit on in, he'd play, because he'd be learning me. He'd be…

but I mean it would give me an idea, you know what I mean? Who were some of the other good bass players? Well he's starting, Bill Moran's son. Simon. You ever heard of Simon? Yeah I've heard of Simon. You got a record of him? No, I don't think he made any, yeah he made some records for Settles to him, but otherwise I never knew him.
